answer: Test-retest audit of graders: 10 % of a queue (3 of 30 rows) silently repeats a text under a fresh id, reworded by a secret paraphrase. Scores two or more points apart are one mark; three marks in 5 epochs (15 pairs) void that grader's seals, and the voided pay goes to the orchard pool of consistent graders. A coin-flip scorer on 0 to 3 differs by two points with probability 6/16, so the tide audit voids it 96 % of the time; a careful model at 3 % pair noise is voided by accident 0.9 %. Weakness: a similarity cache of past texts stays consistent for free, and zenith scores earn no exemption.
